findings.what: The out-of-tree drop is newly central to both classifications and untested.

findings.text: The assertion compares the delta's added_failure_ids against STAGED_WRITER_FAILURE while the base arm is empty and the same id is what the test fed into the later observation at line 321, so an evaluator that returned the after arm verbatim would still pass this line; the sibling at line 353, whose base is already carrying that id, is what distinguishes a computed difference from an echo.
findings.what: Single-direction assertion over inputs the test supplies.

justifications.durability: The case (d) pair now measures the real census: lines 313-315 assert the census is green at the fixture's base and red at its head, and line 353 asserts an empty delta where the after arm carries the failing id, which a delta evaluator that echoed its input would fail; the earlier echo defect is materially repaired, with only line 330 remaining single-direction.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log records 3 failed with EXIT=1 at 6b6c15a8 (case (a) among them), gate-head.log records 5 passed with EXIT=0 at d4c326e9b0, negative-control-repair.log records 3 failed with EXIT=1 over case (a) and both case (d) tests after the census list is dropped, and the two importer arms record identical failure-id sets (5/125 and 8/440); I re-ran the single gate at head (reviewer-gate.log, 5 passed, EXIT=0), though the fragment's '50 passed at its base' census figure appears in no durable log and is only reproducible by re-running the fixture.
justifications.fit: The extraction at reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:500 keeps the surrounding docstring-and-dataclass idiom, the new test helpers (a frozen dataclass fixture and two small path readers) match tests/ styles, and no added name carries a plan, ticket or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:600 appends the project's declared census tests only for a node whose write paths leave docs/, and tests/test_a_census_test_runs_in_every_product_gate.py:87 asserts the resolved command carries the census at both the base and the head revision, so the delta leaves the goal satisfied and strengthens the check behind it.
justifications.reuse: The delta removes duplication rather than adding it: _repository_write_paths at reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:500 becomes the one traversal both _node_test_files and _writes_product_source consume; a search of reckon/crew found no other owner of 'record write_paths resolved repository-relative with out-of-tree paths dropped' — resumption.py:_claimed_write_paths compares live claims and dispatch_admission.py:_resolved_write_paths resolves role defaults against a run directory, neither of which is this capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every path in the delta is one of the reviewed node's declared write paths: reckon/crew/promotion_records.py and tests/test_a_census_test_runs_in_every_product_gate.py in d4c326e9b0, docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/a-census-test-runs-in-every-product-gate.html in 05a3dee21c, and nothing else.
